title: Here’s How Right-Wingers Packed The Courts Well Before Trump
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
[Gutting the Voting Rights Act.](https://zeteo.com/p/the-supreme-court-
shredded-americas) [Overturning Roe v.
Wade.](https://www.npr.org/2022/06/24/1102305878/supreme-court-abortion-roe-v-
wade-decision-overturn) [Ending affirmative
action.](https://www.npr.org/2023/06/29/1181138066/affirmative-action-supreme-
court-decision) These rulings only scratch the surface of the Supreme Court's
continued shift to the right in just the last few years.

But these rulings were actually decades in the making, dating all the way back
to the Reagan administration when the American judiciary was changed forever.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

That's the topic of a new book by MS NOW senior political analyst and Crooked
Media host **Alex Wagner** , called '_The Steal: Four Right-Wing Hard-Liners,
One Republican Presidency, and the Raid on America 's Courts_.'

In a new **" Mehdi Unfiltered"** interview, Wagner breaks down how the **"
outlandish dreams"** of a small group of conservatives to "**corrupt the
courts** " came to fruition, as well as what Supreme Court reforms she
believes the Democratic Party should pursue.

"**The idea of nine berobed elders making these hugely consequential decisions
for American life with no term limits and no ethics code is unconscionable**
,**" **Wagner tells **Mehdi**.

Wagner also expresses her concerns about the current lame duck session of
Congress, and whether a last-ditch effort can be made for Trump to seat a
fourth justice on the Supreme Court.

"**The only thing standing in the way of another Trump nomination is Sam Alito
's ego, which is a powerful thing**," Wagner warns.
